title: US-06 DFD: delete an ingredient

flows.label: Selected ingredient id and access token

rules: All protected input is authenticated and owner-scoped under process 8.0 (US-15). Every referenced object ID, including recipeId in a request body, is checked against the verified account before a read/write. Client owner IDs are rejected or ignored.
A nonexistent id yields 404; a foreign id is denied with 403 or hidden with 404. No denied/missing request changes any entry.
A successful deletion changes only the selected inventory record.
The no-deduction criterion is also modeled by US-08 and US-12: opening or saving a recipe has no D3 write.
